name: abracadabrax-pixel-art-generator
description: Create 8-bit or 16-bit pixel art for indie games and posts: a character sprite, a sprite sheet, items and icons, a tileset or a full scene, rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a character, items or a scene and get pixel art in 8-bit or 16-bit style: a character sprite, a sprite sheet of animation frames, items and icons, a tileset or a full scene.

The plugin prepares a draft with the kind of asset, the bit style, the palette and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders it and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For indie game developers and pixel art fans.

Limitations: new pixel art from text only. It does not convert uploaded photos, export animated GIFs or game-engine files, or copy characters from existing games. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: A 16-bit knight with a red cape and a sword, character sprite
8-bit potions and treasure chests as a set of game items
A sprite sheet of a fox running and jumping, 16-bit

positive.prompt: A 16-bit knight with a red cape and a sword, character sprite. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the character kind, 16-bit style and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: 8-bit potions, keys and treasure chests as a set of game items, Game Boy greens. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the items kind, 8-bit style and the palette. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A sprite sheet of a fox idle, running, jumping and attacking, 16-bit. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the sprite-sheet kind and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A 16-bit pixel art character sprite of a wizard with a blue hat and a staff. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account; get_media_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute image URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: A 16-bit forest scene with mushrooms. Prepare it, then make it 8-bit instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_pixel_art, then update_media_project or prepare_pixel_art again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the 8-bit style, either updated or prepared again. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Turn this photo of my cat into pixel art.
Draw Mario and Link as 16-bit sprites.
Export my sprite as a Unity animation and an animated GIF.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing runs in the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the image link back in the conversation.
